description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HelloController. It provides basic HTTP endpoints for health check, documentation redirect, welcome message, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing basic endpoints to verify application status and offer documentation access.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message indicating the application is running.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects requests to the Swagger UI documentation page, preserving the request scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a simple health status string.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Provides basic information about the application.
